shared_elements: bearded male head in strict profile
hair and beard rendered as rows of tight stylised curls
low-relief human figure with profile head and eye conventions
justification: Both show male figures in strict profile with the same highly conventional treatment of hair and beard as stacked rows of tight curls, a close-fitting patterned cap, and rosette ornament, which is a specific and arbitrary combination unlikely to arise independently. The difference is compositional: A isolates a single enlarged head-and-shoulder bust filling the field, while B is a continuous processional frieze of full-length figures leading horned rams above a border band of rosettes, so the depicted relationships and layout barely overlap.
